about: One-time repairs of fund trades booked wrongly, applied once each at the start of a fund cycle (scripts/fund_cycle.py, fund_ledger.reprice_trade). Applied corrections are kept in the ledger's fund_corrections table and shown in fund_live.json 'corrections'.

corrections.reason: The owner's Nifty Bank trim sold in rupees but was booked at 1 rupee per dollar, adding a false $14,393 profit; re-booked at that cycle's rate (the board's own marks).
